nom: Urban Hydration Bright & Balanced Aloe Vera Leaf Face Wash

avis.texte: I have been using this since November - swtiching from Cerave face wash, looking for Cruelty Free products & I am sooo beyond happy with how it works with my skin. I have very sensitive skin & dont like to switch products often but my skin is GLOWING & looks so much more healthier! Get the Moisterizer too

avis.titre: Rosacea and break outs cleared up
avis.texte: I have oily skin and large pores as well as rosacea flair ups. This is one of the best face washes I've tried for my skin. I've tried many over the years. Pores look better, it's gentle and reduces the redness. A lot less pimples.
Simple and perfect facewash. It also is at a great price point.

I have oily skin, but oily skin face washes are no joke! They clean too much and leave my skin dry afterwards. This face wash doesn't leave my skin dry feeling or tight after I use it (I wash my face 2x a day). It has a scent, smells minty/herbaly. A little goes a long way. Good price for how much product you get. Overall, I would buy this product again.

I've been using this face wash for over a year and I love it because for me, it does what it says. I have oily, acne prone skin. I get a non-irritated, fresh and clean wash without damage to my skin barrier, dryness or stripping. This wash is great for washing off makeup as well as for giving the skin a break from any chemicals/acids from other face wash routines. I mainly use it for these two reasons. This product also helps to keep my skin clear and tone even. I really appreciate the natural ingredients. I sometimes leave it on for 1 to 2 minutes before I rinse. This is my second tube because a little goes a long way.
This is a good face wash if u are looking for something natural, lightweight and refreshing. I like that not much weird ingredients are added to this.
I feel like this the perfect face wash for a simple skin care routine especially for teens!

Alright it ain't bad I love it I was actually quite surprised on how much I loved it it makes your face really smooth and gets rid of hyperpigmentation the only I don't like about is that 1. It has frangeantes and 2. It doesn't get rid of my old dark spots which is what I was hoping for other than that if you buy it you won't regret it
I'm 27, have very oily acne prine skin and I tried this on a whim. I am so happy I did, its been a few weeks but its kept my skin so soft and clear. It helped with my acne tremendously!

I used this face wash about 4 times and started noticing burn like rashes under my eyes and on my lids. Probably just super dried out skin but it's not a good look. The smell is also pretty off putting. Not a fan. :/

my skin was not the greatest -large pores, uneven, dull etc etc && for my age (45) i could NEVER find something that truly worked ...countless products, money wasted && still the same thing UNTIL i walked into ulta one day thinking "OK this is it if i dont find something i give up" well i was actually looking into another product (good molecules) && this line was right next to it ...i bought this face wash along with the papaya toner && some other products (good molecules) -this face wash is pretty good ...i'm not sure if this plays a part in the routine with the other products but whatever it may be they worked -the cashier did mention the products i did get are great products...if you have the same problems as i mentioned earlier then i totally recommend giving these products a try -it totally worked for me when i literally lost all hope

I thought this product would give good results. I had beautiful skin before using this product. It irritated my skin so bad I got rashes on my cheeks and my forehead and between my eyebrows. My face burns and itches now until I can fix this.
Just started using this product and I love it! Gentle and smells amazing not too over bearing. Just natural and the cleanse is great! My skin felt incredibly clean after just one use. Worth a try !
disappointed. i ordered this solely for the vitamin A but the version i received does not have that ingredient. smh.
This stuff is not only good for acne but has definitely helped with fading dark spots and post acne redness. I'm obsessed with it!!

I spent enough on my order to get one of those free 30 piece sampler sets and this came in it. I have sensitive, acne prone skin and the medication I'm on dries it out so much. This was such a nice product to use and didn't make my skin flare up. Price is amazing too. I like to lather mine in my hands until it turns foamy and white before I rub it onto my face!

avis.titre: Best face wash for my eczema
avis.texte: I've been trying different basic non drying face washes for my severe eczema on my face but this is the best so far! It doesn't really lather which means it's less stripping and usually after I'd wash my face w other face washes I'd immediately need moisturizer but with this stuff it's so hydrating I almost forget to put some on, it's also cleared the little bumps and texture I had!!
My face feels very clean following washing it and my mind is at ease knowing that it is cleaner ingredients!

This is a great face wash! My favorite face wash used to be the Simple micellar gel wash before it was discontinued (sad face..) and this one feels a LOT like that one! Maybe even a little stronger of a cleanse which I love as I have oily skin (though I still need to double cleanse if wearing water resistant spf). I know it has fragrance, but it is not strong at all, barely there. Just kind of smells like a natural product smell to me, nice and fresh, if even smelled at all. A little goes a very long way, so the bottle will last a while. I highly recommend!
It did nothing to help my skin, it broke me out really bad. Lucky me I was using a gift card that was used to purchase the 3 products I had brought. It's just not for me
Sensitive, combo, acne-prone skin. Dried me out real bad. I do like the smell and how it lathers but that's about it.

Lucky for me the aloe vera & bottle print grabbed my attention bc I rarely buy stuff I've never even heard of. I'm 54 with - I guess combo skin. I actually noticed my face feeling nice after using it. For me, it's perfect for daily use. It is a challenge for me to find the right amount to get enough lather so I end up using too much regularly. (Someone without ADD will figure it out better than I). So I buy it on sale and if I use a little too much, no biggie, its price is more than fair and I like it. Try it, worse case, you can't wait until its gone or you return to Ulta.
I decided to try the face wash because it has aloe vera, in the first day my face was smooth and this is a miracle face wash!

avis.titre: I love this face soap! The best!
avis.texte: Wow! Just in the first day i can feel my face smooth and hydrated. I totally recommend this soap, it leaves your face smooth and also you can feel your skin clean.
Feels great, cleans my face. I pair it with the moisturizer afterwards. Not drying, gets the dirt and grime off. I mostly just use it after working out to quickly clean my face.

avis.titre: There's a reason their aloe line sells out
avis.texte: This whole line of aloe products from UH are beyond belief. I've used each aloe item and they all have their unique feature and do a fantastic job with sensitive skin.

I used this as a cleanser, absolutely loved! it completely changed my skin. I used it with the ordinary serum and cera va moisturizer it made my skin AMAZING. cant live without, for better results use a face roller
I do not have sensitive skin and have never had a reaction to anything until this face wash. It felt like it was burning my skin and left red marks in spots.

Let me preface this by saying that I will not buy a face wash that doesn't lather. This one lathers, but only if your hands are freshly washed and have no moisturizing agents on them. otherwise it stays gel-like. That kind poses a problem because I don't wear a lot of makeup but do wear moisturizers. I can get the wash to lather in my hands but then the lather dies once it gets to my face. A dime sized amount seems to be the magic amount, and the bottle seems like it will last a long time. With that being said, the smell reminds me of a mild minty scent but without any minty, tingling sensations. It does seem to remove my non-waterproof mascara and eyeshadow, and I haven't had any breakouts or blemishes pop up since using for the last month. I do also like the cleaner ingredients and the gallon of water donation. I can't say for sure that I'd buy this again once I use it up, but it wasn't bad where I felt the need for me to return it.

After using this product for a little over two weeks, it's safe to say I'm happy with the results. I got some really stubborn acne during my last menstrual cycle, like really deep chin acne, and my go-to face cleanser wasn't helping (ACURE's brightening gel cleanser.) I ordered the cleanser and moisturizer from Urban Hydration after reading a ton of reviews and looking up the ingredients on INCIdecoder. The first night I washed my face with lukewarm water as the directions say, followed with Dickinson's rose and witch hazel toner, then applied a hyaluronic acid serum (from artnaturals) and finished with the Urban Hydration moisturizer. The next morning my face was still moisturized, felt smoother, my cheek acne had decreased, and most importantly my deep painful chin pimple was shrinking! Continued using day and night for about days until the acne was pretty much gone, and then changed to just night time. This didn't dry out my skin at all, I just don't prefer to do a full skincare routine in the AM, just toner and moisturizer if needed. I get a pretty oily T-zone no matter what products I use, and unfortunately that still happened with this routine but I think that's more to blame on the moisturizer than the cleanser so I will still leave 5 stars for this review. I tend to use a face powder with salicylic acid when I go out anyway, so I wasn't too worried about a little oiliness. As far as ingredients go, aloe, vitamin A, and citric acid seem to be what makes this product wo
I use this product each morning and night. I love the way it gives my skin balance.

So, I've tried this since I made the review and yeah it lathers nice, but the smell of the aloe Vera is much for me. I don't like that. Cleanse part: I don't feel it does much. Doesn't strip my skin. Just the smell bothers me. Like it should smell better since it's so close to my nose, right? Lol

My first time to use it. I love how it cleanses up into a quick lather. I used a quarter size amount, but I needed only a dime size. Lathers very nice. Super soft on the face. Reminds me of a gel but smoother. The smell is exactly like the aloe Vera plant. Little discomfort to my nose but not overwhelming. My face feels smooth. Shall see how it works with time. I have acne and dry skin. Im 31.
love this product, you can use it daily before deep scrubs and its great at removing dirt, oil, and makeup without stripping the skin of moisture - but it really feels cleansing.

I luv this face wash! It's a good nighttime cleanser because it provides a good deep cleanse without stripping my skin. It has a clear gel look but feels creamy on the face during application. Definitely will repurchase!
This cleanser is great! Love that they use aloe, my skin just drinks it up. I don't feel the tight dryness I sometimes get with other cleansers.

I suffered a heat rash on my face and neck caused by clogged pores from too much sweating which caused me to break out in bumps. I used this face wash along with the Aloe micellar water twice daily, and my skin cleared in less than 10 days. I have sensitive skin so I have to be very careful with products but this worked perfectly! No irritation or issues. After using my skin looks clearer and glowy.
I've been using this face wash for a long time and so happy Ulta carries it now! I used it twice a day with the gel moisturizer after each wash.

I actually found this face wash elsewhere when I was searching for a no-fuss cleanser that would do what I needed it to - cleanse my skin. I'm a big believer that face wash needs to be simple and to save all the fancy ingredients for the products that will actually stay on your skin long enough to be absorbed! This is perfect. Aloe is one of my favorite ingredients! It's nourishing, moisturizing, brightening, clarifying, and perfect for all skin types, even sensitive. I can use this face wash all year without any negatives. I also love that the company is certified Woman-Owned and Minority-Owned! :) One bottle lasts a while and it's a great price point! To take it one step further, I'd love them to create this cleaner in bar form to cut back on plastic waste. Then it would be beyond perfect!

My skin has started clearing up since I using this face wash. My acne is going away and I love that this cleanse my face gently without stripping it. It's perfect for my very sensitive skin and feels soothing after a long day of wearing a mask.
I've had this for a little over a month. Used it daily. Made my face feel very soft. Didn't dry it out like others do. Very gentle on my skin which I have very sensitive skin so that was a huge plus!
I bought this a month ago and I used everyday since I have ezcema it really help my skin it refresh and smell amazing keep my face moisturized after using it.

I'm super picky when it comes to my face, and love this aloe face wash! The texture was a bit odd at first (you can feel the bits of aloe when rubbing your fingers together), but it cleans well and doesn't overly dry my skin. The smell is pleasant and not overpowering. I have not noticed any increase in breakouts since using it, and it worked well in different climates (California, Florida, and Texas). Overall a great basic face wash for normal skin.
I was looking for a southing face wash and I thought I would try this since it contained aloe. It was not greasy feeling and it worked okay. I will try another brand for a good comparison.

I didn't really NEED a facewash - but you don't really NEED to have bad skin to want better skin. My fear of using face washes was all about dried skin. The aloe vera in this face wash makes my face feel even more replenished and has helped remove the tiny little whitehead that pop up around my nose. I use it 4-5 times a week and have noticed quite the difference!

I have been using this face wash for about a month now and I simply do not see much difference in my skin. The cleansing aspect is good, just about what you would expect from any face wash, but it did not significantly affect any blemishes or oil level. I have always had oily skin and I was hoping this product would affect the oil levels of my face, but it did not. The face wash does smell nice. I also was not a huge fan of the consistency as it is a little too watery compared to most face washes.
I bought this a month ago and I loved it. It made my acne not as pronounce and made my ski8n really smooth.

I received this product as a free in home test product all for my personal online opinion about this product in return. This product is highly recommended to anyone and everyone plus is leaves your face smelling great.
I absolutely love this face wash. It doesnt has no odor. Glides on smoothly and not to thick. It left my face freely soft and refreshing.

Foams up nicely and smells pleasant but leaves skin feeling very dry. I have combination skin, which tends to be oily through the T-zone and it really dried my skin out all over. It also takes quite a bit of rinsing to get it all removed.

avis.titre: Liked the feel of it and wash but...
avis.texte: I was really excited to try this face wash. It seemed like a healthy way to clean my face without all the bad stuff. Upon opening I used a pea sized amount on my hand. Comes out clear and definitely smell the aloe. Has a gel feel which makes it easy to apply and it was easy to wash off. My face is not prone to be sensitive to washes but for some reason this seem to irritate mine. I tried again after my face cleared up a little after the first time to make sure and it happened again. Unfortunately I was really disappointed because I really wanted to like this face wash. It could be better for maybe someone else.
I received The Aloe Face Wash a week ago and have been using it every day. It works great. My face feels clean and smooth. No more breakouts.
I love that this is what a healthy face wash that doesn't contain so many bad products the aloe was cooling and felt so good on my skin it also smelled amazing

We got the Urban Hydration - Aloe Face Washto try to help with my combination skin, and help clear up my son's oily skin. It didn't make the oily parts of make face worse, and it definitely helped with the dry portions. Even my 14 yr old son enjoyed it on his face as it didn't sting, or irritate it, but helped with the redness around the areas he did have breakouts. It's a very nice gentle face wash that I could use also on my 10 yr old, because he started getting blackheads from wearing the mask all day at school. So yes I would honestly highly recommend it.

The urban hydration aloe face wash has really helped my face. I like the way it smells and it really makes my face feel clean. I also think it's helped my face not look as dry as it was looking. I would recommend this to anyone looking for a good face wash that isn't drying.

This was a lovely fragrance and a spectacular wash. It leaves your face clean abut does not dry out the skin, It is gentle and effective and is very green as far as ingredients, Iwould highly recommend

The TryIt Sampling Community sent me the Aloe Face Wash to trial and review. The name aloe vera makes me feel like I'm doing something good for my face - it's healing properties and it's ability to stop the growth of bacteria that causes acne is a plus. It has simple ingredients, doesn't dry out your skin, and is simply used with warm water. Very simple procedure to use and time or day and on any type of skin. I would highly recommend this great product!

I love that this face wash smells great without being artificial. It has a light, refreshing almost minty smell that's very relaxing. My skin feels better than ever and this face wash doesn't dry out the skin around my hairline like others have done in the past. It's a thick gel, and a little goes a long way. I apply it to a facial exfoliating brush and scrub as usual. The lather is very nice and my skin feels super clean afterwards. It leaves my skin feeling soft and moisturized without causing oiliness.

I recommend Urban Hydration - Aloe Face Wash because has excellent quality. Rehydration my face is excellent for all types of skin, more is dry skin or senItive really works clean and refresh face skin.

I received a bottle of Urban Hydration Bright & Balanced Aloe Vera Leaf Face Wash for free from tryitsampling in exchange for my review. I love this face wash. It makes my skin feel so soft and hydrated after using it. I also love how this face wash doesn't contain harsh chemicals. I would definitely recommend this face wash to anyone.

I really like this cleanser , I find myself using it in the morning more because it has a cooling effect and I feel like it makes me feel awake! And my skins feels really clean , but it doesn't feel dry after... I notice it helps with my oil control ,and I find myself less oily in my t zone trough the day.

The weather makes my face dry. I've tried this Aloe Vera Leaf Facial Wash and it works wonderful! Gentle on my skin. It's not sticky and has no smell. It has right consistency and easy to wash off. Perfect for all type of skin.

I'm not sure if I just had some irritation but the first time I used this wash it was great. The next time I used it and then did a face mask after my skin was super irritated. The face mask I had done before without any issue. I think it may have negatively interacted with my mask. Overall a nice consistency and fresh feeling on the face for my first use.
I love using this product. I like the scent of it. It makes my face feel fresh and clean. Not sticky. I have recommended this product to my sisters and mom.

It leaves your face feel moisturized and smooth after using. It's great for my sensitive skin and doesn't irritate it. I also like how it has natural ingredients in it. I noticed that I have less breakouts. You don't need a lot either and lathers up really nice. You need to be careful when using it or else too much will come out.

I have to admit that, at first, I was a bit disappointed that this face wash doesn't have the chemical burn of a salicylic acid product nor the abrasive scrub of an exfoliating product. But I kept reminding myself that it was all natural and, for that, it was worth a second and third and fourth try. And, you know what... I think I've come around to it. The light tree tree scent is lovely without being overpowering. My face certainly feels clean and not over dry after using. And, dare I say, I believe it has cleared up the bit of mask acne that had begun to form on my jawline. Not bad.

I have dry skin and found this face wash to work well for me without being too drying or stripping. It smelled nice and rinsed clean. My skin felt clean and nourished. My husband has oily skin and some eczema issues, and he also really enjoyed this cleanser. It cleansed without over drying or irritating skin and worked well on his eczema-prone areas. This works well for a variety of skin types.

I wanted to try the Urban Hydration-Aloe Vera Leaf Face Wash because I know aloe helps with so many things. I wanted to see how well aloe would work at cleansing my face. Besides smelling very clean & refreshing (smells minty), it's very light-weight & you only need a small amount. At first when I used it, it didn't do the usual foaming like most soaps do so I figured it wouldn't work well. I was wrong! I normally wear all day/long wearing foundation so it takes a little more effort to get my face clean. After using this product, with just my fingers rubbing the face wash on to my skin, it got my skin extremely clean. I even did a test after I washed my face by taking one of my make-up remover cloths & going over my face to see if there was any residue. The cloth was clean! Afterwards my face felt clean & residue free. I was extremely happy with this product & would definitely recommend it!
I love this face wash. It is very easy to use. It has my face so soft after I use.
Love this face wash! It's light in scent and texture. I especially like the natrual ingredients used. Aloe in a face wash is genius. Doesn't dry out your face & I can tell its improving my texture.

I have to start out by saying not only do I love this fash wash, so does my pre-teen! It is wo easy to apply, I do it in the shower and rinse! There is no over bearing scent, just a light clean aloe scent! It has not caused it issues with my skinor my preteens! I am highly recording this product!

This is a great face wash. I have fairly sensitive skin so I'm very careful about the products that I use. I was not disappointed at all this is a great face wash! It removes all my make up and dirt and I noticed my face has been breaking out less.

avis.titre: Great way to smooth your skin
avis.texte: This face wash really leaves my skin feeling so soft and clean. It really helped the appearance of my dry skin since it helps to hydrate my face. I love the fact that it has many natural ingredients and nothing harmful to your skin. It only takes a small amount to get a lot of lather.

This product cleanses the face very well, does not dry out, does not irritate the skin, does not have a bad smell. Contains natural ingredients, free of chemicals. Leaves skin soft and fresh. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest and honest opinion.

So first off this stuff smells sooooo good. I love thats its natural. Always leaves my face feeling super soft & fresh after. The only downfall is I wish it had a different tube. Because you do not need much to clean your face. But whenever I squeeze some product out. So much comes out on accident. Maybe it's just user error lol.

I have been using the Urban Hydration - Aloe Face Wash for about three weeks now . I really like the gentle cleansing . Even though I am in my 40's I have been experiencing some mild acne . The last few years I have tried a few different face wash products and most of them dried my face out badly . This product leaves my skin smooth and hydrated .I no longer have any issues with acne or breakouts since I've been using it . The scent is pleasant and not over whelming. It's definitely my new favorite face wash. I look forward to trying other products from this line .

OK to start off if you read the ingredients you realize that the name is very misleading it only has very I mean very little aloe in it at all . It was very thick and felt like jelly . It did however heal my broken out skin so that was a plus . Would I recommend not really .

I have used this product religiously and my skin is amazing. It's made my face so soft and reduced my acne a ton.! It doesn't hurt my sensitive skin and smells so good.! I absolutely love this face wash.! Great find.!

This ace wash feels sooo refreshing after each use. I have very oily skin and this has helped sooo much even thou I haven't been using it I can already see a difference, and the best part is that it doesn't make my skin dry/.

I saw this face wash in the store so I decided to give it a try. I am in love with how this face wash makes my face feel. It has a light smell to it which is great because I can't tolerate a lot of fragrances. This face wash made my skin feel nice and smooth and didn't leave that weird filmy feel on my face like some products do. I am in love with this face wash.

I love the smell of this face wash. It gets down in the pores and leaves my face feeling fresh and clean. I have combination skin. So sometimes my face can be really oily and when it is this doesn't work well.

I've been using the urban hydration aloe face wash for about 3 weeks now. It has a gel like consistency and it's very easy to dispense. A little goes a long way. It foams easily and doesn't dry the skin after.

I have been using Bright & Balanced Aloe Vera Leaf Face Wash for just over a week. I like how lightly scented it is. It only takes about a pea size amount to make a nice suds to wash your face. I have a small area of eczema it has helped with as it also helps with moisturizing all my face.
This Aloe Vera Leaf face wash works great. It is not sticky or heavy and you really do only need a pea size to clean your face with. It leaves your face feeling smooth and clean.
I got this Urban Hydration - Aloe Face Wash about 2 weeks ago and it is one of the best face washes I have ever used. My face felt really soft and clean immediately after I used it.

I spent a lot of time this Summer getting too much sun and too much chlorine. LOL. This helped cool my skin and I felt like it helped quench and repair my skin from all of the crazy activities I was doing this Summer.
I got the Urban hydration-Aloe face wash, leaves my face super clean and polished. It smells great too. The formula is lightweight yet great foaming action! It's perfect for sensitive skin!

I love this face wash! This has helped my skin stay moisturize while still adding those detox benefits of the aloe vera. I love how this leaves my skin super smooth, I've notices a huge different with dark spots I had that are completely gone, and i've had less acne overall. I highly recommend this face wash.

I have been using this face wash for a couple of weeks and I can notice the difference. My skin feels soft and smooth, it has tremendously helped with controlling my acne. This face wash is not harsh at all so it does not leave my face red. My skin feels refreshed and clean.

I am quite satisfied with this aloe face wash!! It is very refreshing with a great, but not overpowering, scent. It works great to hydrate my skin and I have not had an issue with it drying it out at all. I love the use of natural ingredients as well, aloe is a great plant.

I received this face wash a few days ago. It is easy to use and rinses off great. Iike the way it makes my face feel after. It seems to moisturize after without having to put anything else on. It has one and vitamin a and e. If you are looking for something new to wash your face this might be the product for you.

I really enjoyed this face wash. I use it in the shower. It has a nice light fragrance and a feel of rubbing Aloe Vera on your skin. It did not dry out my face and made me feel like it already had lotion on after getting out of the shower.
This facewash is very healing and soothing for my skin. It doesn't leave any residue behind and my skin feels great!
I have been using this in the evenings to wash the oil and dirt from the day and my skin feels amazing!

I received this as a sample in exchange for my honest review. I like that this is a natural product, by a family that cares about what goes into their products. It has a nice light scent, which I like, and foams up nicely, which I also really like.

This Urban Hydration Bright & Balanced Aloe Vera Leaf Face Wash is simply a wonderful face wash product, it is a gel face wash, not a scrub. I suppose with all the vitamins and fruit extracts is what helps clean my face so well, my face feels so clean and refreshed after I use this, it has a cooling sensation too. Furthermore, the Aloe Vera Leaf leaves my skin so moisturize and fresh looking. After using this face wash for 2 weeks my skin looks so clear and radiant, and leave my skin feeling so smooth too. The eczema spots on my cheeks are gone, no more itchy feeling, my face just feels so wonderful, even the prescription lotion I was using didn't do this well of a job. It seems unbelievable but those dark spots I had from the eczema are almost gone too. Just 2 weeks and the practically disappeared. I am definitely be using this face wash from now on, it is my favorite face wash. I would highly recommend this to all my friends and family.

I love the Aloe face wash because it makes make face feel cool and refreshed. It doesn't really lather up but it does clean deep down inside the pores leaving your face glowing and smooth. Most of all the Aloe face wash smells Amazing! It's a cool mint that feels nice and cool in your face!
I was happy to have received this face wash. Overall it's a great face wash that cleans well and is not too harsh. It has a decent smell. It has worked well on my acne prone skin.

I have been using this face wash for almost a month now and I love it. This face wash itself has a texture similar to aloe vera gel, which is something that I like. This face wash also does lather too much. I can always feel a slight tingling sensation with this face wash. Most importantly, I like that this face wash doesn't leave my face feeling stripped.
The urban hydration aloe face wash is a excellent product. I don't have oily skin but I do have a lot of dark spots. It is a light feeling product, easy to use, and has a nice light scent.

I have used this aloe face wash from Urban Hydration in the past week and it is great. It cleans my skin well and does not overly dry it out. It does makes my skin feel refreshed and it is great that is not made of harsh chemicals like other products. I definitely recommend.
I always buy aloe product.This is safe to use. This is good to use.

I love this face wash. It feels so smooth on my face. It is very thick which means I really have to work it into my skin. I actually like that because it forces me to take a little bit of extra time for myself. I also like that it doesn't make my skin feel super dry after I finish using it.
This face wash is effective, and it feels like it is good for you. I really like the light scent, the non-greasy feel, and the clean feeling it leaves you with.

I started using this and my face has been smooth and not dry like it was .This is easy to use because it feels good on your face and has a nice and pleasant smell. I use this now on a daily basis and my skin has gotten so much better.
I love how it moistures my face. I have sensitive skin. It amazed me how it didn't break my face out. I rate this a 10 out of 10. I highly recommend this facial moisturizer.
Bought this face wash a few months ago i suffer from terrible acne and within a few weeks my skin has cleared up completely it now buy this regularly it works well

I received the Urban Hydration, Bright & Balanced Aloe Vera Leaf Face wash a few weeks ago. The face wash size is 6.0 fl. Oz. It comes in an easy to squeeze bottle with a flip cap. The face wash according to container does not contain any parables, silicone, phthalates, and sulfates. The container states it is blended with aloe leaf juice & vitamins A, E . The face wash comes in a clear color. The smell of the face wash is not overwhelming. To me it smells almost like peppermint. The face wash is thicker consistently and lathers up good when mixed with water. The lather is not extreme but enough to clean your face with i felt. After use of the face wash i felt my face was fresh and clean. It did not dry my face out. Also it did not sting my eyes. The fragrance did not linger after use that I could notice. I feel this face wash would be good for anyone.
Was a nice green color ,and packaged well. Clean smell ,liked the feel of it on my face. There wasn't any greasy feeling afterwords.There are no bad ingredients.helps moisturizes.

The Urban Hydration Aloe Face Wash is extremely calming and moisturizing for my combination skin. Some face washes can irritate my acne and even cause cystic acne for me. This face wash easily took off my makeup and didn't dry out my skin.

So it was rasy to applr,,a little runny on your hands had odd smell, not bad just different. I didnt notice anything different with mt skin while using this product . I tend to have a oily skin so maybe thats why a saw no effect positive or negative

I bought this, as I am switching over from chemical-laden products to natural products, but was not happy with the bottle. The face wash itself was great (the fragrance was fantastic), but the bottle leaked just too much. Would be much better in a pump bottle.

This Urban Hydration face wash is pretty good I have been using it twice a day for a couple of weeks and my face has never felt so fresh and clean most face washes dry out my skin or leave behind some film but not this time it leaves my skin clean smooth and even some of my dry spots have gone away I would 100% recommend this face wash

Love this face wash. It is thick and smell is light. Just need little amount of face wash to clean face the only thing is it take some time to make foam because it is thick. Other than that it cleans good feels good and skin is feeling soft. All ingredients are good for skin.

This is the first time I have tried and heard of Urban Hydration Aloe Vera face wash. This is great for every skin type. It is free from parabens, silicones, phthalates, and sulfates. It is made of extract from the aloe vera plant and also has vitamins A & E, which are great for the skin. It has a mild minty scent. The product claims that is is great for oily skin, acne prone skin, psoriasis and eczema. I have definitely noticed that it is very moisturizing and my skin feels great after using it. However, I've been using it for a few weeks now and it doesn't seem to be helping my acne at all. This face wash has a slightly thick consistency and does not require much at all to clean your face. This large bottle can easily last for months. Despite not helping with acne, it is all around a great face wash and I would recommend it.

avis.titre: Great for my eczema prone skin!
avis.texte: I recently received this aloe face wash by Urban Hydration and was pleasantly surprised how well it helped to reduce the signs of my facial eczema. Over the past few years, I have been dealing with extremely dry and scaly skin on my face as a result of my eczema. I have felt hopeless at times that I would never find a product that worked well at reducing or eliminating this issue. I believe this face wash is finally the product I have been seeking. It is so simple and easy to apply and I noticed results in only a couple days. After 2 weeks of using this product once a day, my skin has felt moisturized and the redness has been nearly eliminated. My confidence has increased so much and I no longer get anxiety thinking that people are staring at my skin. Even better, this company gives back to the community. If you are an individual who suffers from eczema symptoms on your face then this is the product for you and I would highly recommend it.

I bought this to help keep outbreaks under control. It made my face smoother, softer and soooo refreshed. I use it daily now, in the morning to help wake up, and at night to help me sleep. I've already got my sister in law a bottle and she loves it too.

As great as this felt on this skin I noticed no difference, maybe that's a good thing? Things didn't get worse. But no major improvements. Smells good and I feel cleaner afterwards but nothing really changed

I got the Aloe Face Wash and in using it I felt it was not very good as a deep cleaning face wash. It was much better as a daily end of the day face wash to remove makeup from the day. My skin felt clean and refreshed after using it.

I struggle with dry, red skin and an constantly looking for a facial cleanser that smoothes, soothes and smells great. This aloe wash does it all. I am left with a satisfying clean sense and feel refreshed. There is no redness from an overly abrasive cleanser either.

avis.titre: Skin is soft and breaks out less
avis.texte: Takes very little to do your whole face. Leaves my skin feeling very soft. I didn't find it to have much of a smell so that was a plus since I don't like overly scented products especially on my face. I have notice a little difference in my face breaking out less. It's definitely worth trying

Product has a nice clean smell and lathers up nicely with a small amount of product. Did not dry my face out like many other products do. Had calm and soothing feel while washing which I am sure is from the Aloe Vera. i have noticed that the redness in my face has gone down quite a bit since using this product.
